item.title: Trusted European Media Data Space Project (TEMS)
item.description: TEMS project is powered by the European Commission and developed by a consortium of 43 organizations representing hundreds of stakeholders from 14 countries in the cultural and creative sectors. It is a core element in the implementation of the European Data Strategy. Project Website is available at: https://tems-dataspace.eu/

item.title: The 2025 European Media Industry Outlook report
item.description: The second edition of the European Commission’s European Media Industry Outlook has been published on 4th September 2025. The European Media Industry Outlook explores media trends and analyses their potential impact in EU media markets. It expands on the first edition, published in May 2023, by providing new consumer data from all EU Member States.
